posts.title_en: Skill amplification isn't best for every cookie (서신우)
posts.summary_en: Read from the subtitle-band sheets (subs-7ZcZXq0zUmE-*). Skill amp is the best rune line in general, but read each skill: where the text says amplification doesn't apply (Pinot Noir; the Cake Hound's damage-reduction buff), amp is a dead line, and haste is dead when the skill's cooldown is no longer than its duration (Pinot 9.5 s/10 s, Cake Hound 7.25 s/6.5 s). Chardonnay: only push resistance ignores amp, and her cooldown (4 s) is shorter than her duration (5 s), so she takes all skill amp.

advice.text: Check a skill's text for 'amplification not applied' before rolling skill amp; check cooldown against duration before rolling haste.
Chardonnay: all skill amp (the author's pinned comment adds that haste also works in Arena, where she deals damage).

damage.text: Skill amp only pays on effects it applies to; haste only when the skill's cooldown exceeds its duration.

quotes.kr: 증폭이 제일 좋고 이것만 뽑기는 어려우니
quotes.en: (narration, sheet subs-7ZcZXq0zUmE-00) Amp is the best, but it is hard to roll only that.
(narration, sheet subs-7ZcZXq0zUmE-04) Give Chardonnay all amp.

posts.summary_en: The creator's pinned comment lists gear sub-stats per preset. Stage: weapons accuracy + (amp, ATK, crit rate, crit dmg); armour by power; upper accessories accuracy/focus + (haste, ATK, crit); lower accessories focus + (haste, DR, HP, DEF); accuracy can sit ~300 and focus ~200 below the stage's line. Conquest: no accuracy, focus or crit resistance, and displayed power doesn't matter, so take weaker-power gear with better lines: weapons amp + (ATK, crit rate, crit dmg); armour DR + (HP, DEF); upper accessories haste + (amp, ATK, crit); lower accessories haste + (DR, HP, DEF). Arena: as Conquest but crit resistance counts on armour and lower accessories; with Moon Rabbit stripping crit, the Conquest preset can serve Arena.

advice.text: Keep separate stage, Conquest and Arena presets; outside stages pick gear by its lines, not its displayed power.

damage.text: Weapons amp first; armour DR; upper accessories haste; lower accessories haste; crit resistance, accuracy and focus are dead lines.
Conquest lines plus crit resistance on armour and lower accessories.

quotes.kr: 여기서는 명중, 집중, 치저가 필요 없고 권투력을 챙길 필요가 없기 때문에
quotes.en: (pinned comment) Here accuracy, focus and crit resistance aren't needed, nor recommended power.

advice.text: (comment) Arena/Conquest: top-left amp + crit; bottom-right haste + DR; top-right haste + amp; bottom-left DR + HP. Stage: power + accuracy/focus.
